market_outlook.short_term: Markets face choppy 1-3 month period: oil volatility from Iran conflict counters AI-driven equity optimism. Bond yields climbing toward 5.5% threshold creates headwind. Fed September decision is binary catalyst. Earnings season shows top-line strength but margin compression. Expect range-bound equities with sector rotation favoring energy, financials, and AI infrastructure over pure-play GPU names.
market_outlook.long_term: 6-12 month outlook constructive for quality equities if oil stabilizes below $110. AI capex supercycle extends to Gulf data centers and networking. China stabilization via capital injection supports EM recovery. Energy transition faces critical minerals misallocation risk. Housing sector under structural pressure from rates. Healthcare shows binary biotech risk with services resilience. India manufacturing double-digit growth offers EM diversification.
